q: What if occupancy increases by 50%, impact on other domains

resp.title: What if occupancy increases by 50%, impact on other domains

messages.text: What if occupancy increases by 50%, impact on other domains
The occupancy sensor at KH reported 0 in every hour in the last 7 days, so the device's data cannot estimate what a change of +50% would do. Ask again once it has recorded the building in use.
